notes.title: 🎥 Behind the Scenes of Blippo+ - A Tease of the game's making of documentary
notes.content:
Ambitious to the point of danger: what did it take to create Blippo+? COMING SOON: a behind-the-scenes look at building Planet Blip!

Check out this teaser for the upcoming making-of documentary and get to meet some of the people who made it happen.

[previewyoutube="Yf15ePYWvzE;full"][/previewyoutube]Blippo+ arrives on Home Computers September 23rd! 💻
